name: io.github.iowarp/paraview-mcp
title: CLIO Paraview
description: MCP server for ParaView scientific visualization

tools.name: load_scientific_data
tools.description: Load scientific datasets (VTK, EXODUS, CSV, RAW, BP5) into ParaView with automatic format detection.

tools.name: save_contour_as_stl
tools.description: Save the active contour or surface as an STL file in the data directory.

tools.name: create_geometric_shape
tools.description: Create a geometric source (Sphere, Cone, Cylinder, Plane, or Box).

tools.name: generate_isosurface
tools.description: Create an isosurface visualization of the active source at the given isovalue.

tools.name: create_data_slice
tools.description: Create a slice plane through the loaded volume data.

tools.name: configure_volume_display
tools.description: Toggle volume rendering visibility for the active source.

tools.name: toggle_visibility
tools.description: Toggle visibility for the active source.

tools.name: set_active_source
tools.description: Set the active pipeline object by its registered name.

tools.name: get_active_source_names_by_type
tools.description: List pipeline source names, optionally filtered by type.

tools.name: edit_volume_opacity
tools.description: Edit the opacity transfer function for a scalar field.

tools.name: set_color_map
tools.description: Set a custom color transfer function for volume rendering.

tools.name: apply_field_coloring
tools.description: Color the active visualization by a specific data field.

tools.name: compute_surface_area
tools.description:
Compute the surface area of the active dataset (must be a surface mesh).

Returns:
    Status message with area value.

tools.name: set_color_map_preset
tools.description: Apply a predefined color map preset (e.g., Viridis, Plasma, Cool to Warm).

tools.name: set_representation_type
tools.description: Set the representation type for the active source (Surface, Wireframe, Points, etc.).

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description:
Get the current visualization pipeline structure.

Returns:
    Description of the current pipeline.

tools.name: get_available_arrays
tools.description:
List available data arrays in the active source.

Returns:
    List of available arrays.

tools.name: get_histogram
tools.description: Compute histogram data for a field in the active source.

tools.name: generate_flow_streamlines
tools.description: Create streamlines from a vector volume using the StreamTracer filter.

tools.name: take_viewport_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current ParaView viewport and save it as a timestamped PNG.

tools.name: show_screenshot_preview
tools.description: Capture a screenshot with inline preview using temporary files.

tools.name: rotate_camera
tools.description: Rotate the camera by azimuth and elevation angles in degrees.

tools.name: reset_camera
tools.description:
Reset the camera to show all data in the viewport.

Returns:
    Status message.

tools.name: plot_over_line
tools.description: Create a 'Plot Over Line' filter to sample data between two points.

tools.name: warp_by_vector
tools.description: Apply a 'Warp By Vector' filter to the active source.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description:
List all available commands in this ParaView MCP server.

Returns:
    List of available commands.

resources.name: paraview_capabilities
resources.description: ParaView visualization capabilities and supported formats.

prompts.name: visualize_data
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating a ParaView visualization.
